messages:
Sofia (People Ops): Heads up 1 — Priya flagged that two interviewers for R-4021 couldn't open the scorecard and never got the interviewer training invite. Can someone investigate?
Priya (Hiring Manager): They showed up in the panel but scorecard button was greyed out. I asked them to check their email; nothing. We interview tomorrow morning.
Carlos (Recruiting Ops): I see similar for two other reqs, R-4018 and R-4020. Quick look at the ATS audit shows duplicate user records for the same email with different IDs (case mismatch). Likely vendor import dedupe problem.
Raj (Platform Eng): Looking at the webhook log, vendor system sent both `alice@example.com` and `Alice@Example.com` as separate upserts. Our importer used raw email as the dedupe key. Not ideal. Example payloads: ```{"action":"upsert","email":"alice@example.com","role":"interviewer","user_id":"u-9981"}``` and ```{"action":"upsert","email":"Alice@Example.com","role":"interviewer","user_id":"u-9982"}```
Carlos (Recruiting Ops): That explains it. The scorecard assigner matched on user_id, so the duplicate got no template. Also our training-job filters on `is_primary_account=true`.
Vendor-ops-bot: Vendor import batch 2026-11-18 processed with 482 users, 3 warnings (email case variance).
Sofia (People Ops): Ok, short-term we need: 1) attach scorecards to the duplicates' active accounts, 2) re-send interviewer training invites, 3) plan a dedupe fix so this doesn't recur.
Raj (Platform Eng): I can push a quick patch to normalize emails to lowercase before dedupe in the importer. Will open PR for staging with the test vector. Long-term we should de-duplicate on normalized email and phone, and surface import warnings in the UI.
Carlos (Recruiting Ops): For the immediate fix I can run a script to map duplicate accounts and attach `sc-101` to the correct account, then bulk-invite training link `https://learn.internal/interviewer-package`. I'll handle R-4018, R-4020, R-4021 now.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Thanks. Please confirm when invites are sent so I can notify the candidates/interviewers.
Raj (Platform Eng): PR: https://git.internal/redwood/recruiting-import/pull/427 - normalizes `email.toLowerCase()` and adds a warning counter. Deploy staging in ~30m.
ATS-bot: scorecard attach task queued for R-4021 by Carlos.
Carlos (Recruiting Ops): Invites resent to the four affected interviewers and scorecards attached. I left comments on each candidate timeline and pinged the interviewers.
Vendor-ops-bot: Notified vendor of case-sensitive email issue; vendor confirmed they will normalize client-side for future batches.
Sofia (People Ops): Fabulous. Raj, once staging looks good, can you schedule a prod deploy tomorrow morning? Also can you add a nightly audit job that flags users created with email duplicates.
Raj (Platform Eng): Yes to both. I'll add the audit job (daily) and a dashboard alert. Target prod deploy 09:00 PST tomorrow after smoke tests.
Carlos (Recruiting Ops): Follow-up task: run a one-week audit of newly created interviewer accounts to ensure scorecard and invite flows are green. I'll own that.
Priya (Hiring Manager): Appreciate the quick teamwork. See you tomorrow 44d
Sofia (People Ops): Closing notes: actions assigned - Carlos: immediate attach & invites + 1-week audit. Raj: importer lowercase patch + nightly audit + prod deploy. Vendor-ops: normalize exports. I'll add to the recruiting ops runbook and notify HMs.
